items.title: Klopp moet mogelijke debutant wegstrepen uit zijn XXL-selectie
items.summary: Brajan Gruda van RB Leipzig moet nog even geduld hebben voor een mogelijk debuut in het Duitse nationale elftal. De aanvallende middenvelder (22) heeft zich vanwege een buikblessure afgemeld bij bondscoach Jürgen Klopp.

items.title: Chivu troeft oude leermeester Mourinho af en pakt Inter-record
items.summary: Door het gelijkspel op bezoek bij AS Roma heeft Cristian Chivu een record op zijn naam gebracht. De trainer van Internazionale had slechts 43 Serie A-duels nodig om de grens van honderd punten te bereiken. Geen enkele trainer van de Nerazzurri deed dat sneller.

items.title: Gakpo nieuwe rechtsbuiten van Oranje? 'Zijn instelling is top'
items.summary: Het afgelopen WK was voormalig bondscoach Ronald Koeman zoekende naar de ideale speler op de rechtsbuitenpositie. In Rondje Buitenland filosoferen Süleyman Öztürk en Bas van den Hoven, beiden kenner buitenlands voetbal, om Cody Gakpo te posteren op die positie in het Nederlands elftal. Hoewel de 'EinTovenaar' zijn beste spel heeft laten zien op de linksbuitenpositie, maakt hij bij zijn eigen club Liverpool ook indruk aan de andere kant van het veld.

items.title: Palmer & Rice among five withdrawals from England squad
items.summary: Tino Livramento, Kobbie Mainoo, Cole Palmer, Marcus Rashford and Declan Rice all pull out of England's squad for forthcoming Nations League matches.

items.title: Do or die voor Jong Oranje: de problemen die Reiziger moet oplossen
items.summary: Het zijn de weken van de waarheid voor Jong Oranje. De ploeg van Michael Reiziger moet deze interlandperiode presteren, om het EK niet mis te lopen. Een stand van zaken over de hoofdpijndossiers en de mogelijke oplossingen.

items.title: Go Ahead Eagles komt doelpunten tekort: 'Dit is iets dat we moeten leren'
items.summary: Go Ahead Eagles staat na zeven duels op tien punten. Dat hadden er echter meer kunnen zijn, als de ploeg van Joseph Oosting wat beter met zijn kansen was omgegaan. Go Ahead creëert voldoende, maar beloont zichzelf te weinig.

items.summary: Was Gary Neville right to call out Manchester United for a "lack of effort" in their 1-1 draw at Fulham on Sunday?

items.title: Football Daily | Brighton’s organised chaos viciously pecks Arsenal into submission
items.summary: Sign up now! Sign up now! Sign up now? Sign up now! For an elite head coach who isn’t used to seeing his team lose, suffering a rare defeat on the weekend before an international break is particularly hard to take. With the vast majority of your players hightailing it out of Dodge to rack up more air miles than Santa Claus across a decade’s worth of Christmas Eves, the chance to quickly put things right simply isn’t an option. With the first lull of the season set to be longer than any before, the potential for introspection, self-flagellation and over-thinking has never been higher. Luckily, Mikel Arteta has never struck Football Daily as the kind of intense, brooding and meticulous perfectionist likely to spend the next 19 days beating himself up over the monstering his team suffered from Brighton on Saturday. Whether it’s forlornly moving magnets around a tactics board or walking Win the dog around Arsenal’s largely-deserted training ground until her little legs are stumps, we’re confident the Arsenal boss’s every fleeting thought over the next three weeks will not be laser-focused on the manner in which the Seagulls viciously pecked his team of champions into submission and how best to ensure such a humiliation is never repeated. Oxford United’s decision to market an American college-themed ‘United 93’ kit shortly after the 9/11 anniversary, only then to have to recall it (Friday’s Football Daily, full email edition), is a tad unfortunate. But until 1960 they were known as Headington United, from their heady days in the Southern League. So I am eagerly awaiting the ‘1960 Ron Atkinson’ range celebrating both their history and leading appearance maker (still)” – Jon Harris. Following Andros Townsend’s freak (but miraculously not serious) on-pitch accident, will future fixtures between Prachuap and Pattani be known as the Roller derby?” – Phil Taverner. OK. I messed up. On 30 August, I made a claim that Emilio Martínez’s transfer to Chelsea for £7.5m might be the bargain of the season. Now five games in and 12 goals conceded, I wish to retract my statement. I will try to do better and stay away from any rash predictions” – Nigel Sanders. Football knowledge aside, I take great pride in knowing a lot about The Simpsons (earlier years especially … I haven’t watched it in about a decade). It was Wiggum who advised to dig up, not Homer (Friday’s Football Dailly letters)” – Mark Shrewsbury. Continue reading...

items.title: Paper trail of protests: José Mourinho plays the hits in Madrid derby defeat | Sid Lowe
items.summary: Facing Diego Simeone 13 years on, José Mourinho brought a print-out and paranoia. Some things don’t change. Some people don’t, either There were many questions to emerge from the Madrid derby, which Atlético won 2-1 in front of 70,514 very, very noisy people at the Metropolitano on Sunday afternoon, even if not the one José Mourinho was asking. Like: what year is this? Or: what was Dean Huijsen thinking? Why always Arda? And whatever happened to Vinícius Júnior? How come Koke is still the best? And how long before Giuliano Simeone actually bursts, his atlético insides exploding across the pitch? Above all though, you were left wondering: where did Real Madrid’s manager get a printer from? And how did he get the bloody thing to work? You could still hear the singing outside when Mourinho turned up in the press room, laid down his glasses and sat. In his hand was a piece of paper. Thirteen years after his last derby, on the Santiago Bernabéu night when Madrid lost the Copa del Rey final and a 13-year unbeaten run against their neighbours, Diego Simeone had defeated him again. The stage was new – this stadium didn’t exist then – but his adversary was somehow still the same man, still dressed in black, and the scene was a bit like old times, a classic. Mourinho unfolded the paper and held it up. “We can save ourselves the bother of the press conference,” he said, “because the story is right here.” Continue reading...

items.title: Celtic can't sack manager O'Neill, says Lambert
items.summary: Martin O'Neill leaving Celtic would not surprise Paul Lambert, but the former club captain would be "shocked and disappointed" if the veteran manager was to be sacked.

items.title: Thomas Tuchel rocked by five key withdrawals from England squad
items.summary: Palmer, Rice, Mainoo, Rashford and Livramento injured James Garner and Morgan Gibbs-White called-up as cover Thomas Tuchel has been rocked by a host of withdrawals from his England squad, with Cole Palmer, Declan Rice, Kobbie Mainoo, Marcus Rashford and Tino Livramento all out because of injury. The head coach has called up James Garner and Morgan Gibbs‑White to boost his options for the upcoming Nations League programme. Tuchel gave Palmer a high-profile recall on Friday for the beginning of the two-year international cycle that he hopes will end in glory at Euro 2028. England are back in the top division of the Nations League and they kick off against Spain at Wembley on Saturday. They then play Czechia and Croatia away before returning to Wembley to face Czechia. Continue reading...

items.title: Ghosts of 2023 quelled after Dortmund return to the Bundesliga summit | Andy Brassell
items.summary: It is probably a stretch to call BVB title contenders but Niko Kovac’s side maintained their 100% start against Stuttgart Borussia Dortmund would probably rather not think about the last time that they topped the Bundesliga. It was in May 2023, just before all their dreams imploded, with black and yellow Deutscher Meister t-shirts – ‘German champions’ – for sale on the approach to Signal Iduna Park and cold beers at the ready. Now, that is no longer the most recent time Dortmund have led the pack. It’s four games, four wins to start this season and the Niko Kovac workout plan is hitting the spot. Saturday night’s single-goal win at Stuttgart was a game that had the gravitas of a true Topspiel, if not quite the entertainment value of one. Kovac’s fingerprints were all over it. The conversation of whether his view of the game fits with BVB’s swashbuckling image will no doubt continue, but this was a case in point to show just how good Kovac has been for the club, and for the team. Continue reading...

items.title: Granit Xhaka admits to receiving fake Covid vaccination certificate in 2022
items.summary: Sunderland captain withdrawn from Switzerland squad He will be questioned by prosecutor’s office in Lucerne Granit Xhaka has been withdrawn from Switzerland’s squad after he admitted receiving a fake Covid vaccination certificate in 2022. The Sunderland and Switzerland captain – who was an Arsenal player at the time – has apologised for this “mistake” and will sit out his country’s forthcoming four Nations League matches. Xhaka is poised to be questioned by the prosecutor’s office in Lucerne next week as it decides whether any criminal proceedings will be initiated regarding the alleged issue of a series of false Covid certificates by a doctor based in the Swiss city during the pandemic. The doctor, who was first investigated in 2023, has denied the allegations. Continue reading...

items.title: Nathan De Cat est en difficulté, mais qu'en est-il des autres transferts sortants d'Anderlecht ?
items.summary: On a beaucoup pu parler de la situation de Nathan De Cat à Hoffenheim : titulaire en Europe, le jeune talent de Neerpede est passé à côté de son match, et était de retour sur le banc ce week-end. À l'heure de la première trêve internationale de la saison, où en sont les autres transferts sortants du RSC Anderlecht ?

items.title: Mark Van Bommel krijgt onverwachte puzzel bij zijn eerste selectie
items.summary: Jérémy Doku ontbreekt bij de eerste selectie van Mark van Bommel, hoewel hij opnieuw minuten maakte voor Manchester City. Daardoor schuiven andere flankspelers nadrukkelijk naar voren bij de Rode Duivels, met Mika Godts en Diego Moreira als interessante opties.

items.title: L'une des bonnes surprises du début de saison : formé au Standard pendant six ans, il impressionne en D1B
items.summary: Le football belge apprend petit à petit à connaître le Sporting Hasselt. L'un des tauliers des Limbourgeois vient de Welkenraedt. Lucas Vankerkhoven rêvait de lancer sa carrière professionnelle au Standard, son club formateur, c'est finalement un peu plus au nord qu'il s'impose en patron.

items.title: Et si un Mauve prenait du temps de jeu durant la trêve pour faire souffler un titulaire ?
items.summary: Oleg Reabciuk n'a pas encore fait ses débuts avec le RSC Anderlecht. Arrivé hors-forme après de longs mois sans jouer, le Moldave est cependant bel et bien prêt à jouer, et pour lui, la trêve arrive peut-être au meilleur des moments.

items.title: "Hij had een selectie voor de Rode Duivels verdiend": Vandenbempt vol lof over JPL-speler
items.summary: Union SG blijft verbazen in de Jupiler Pro League. Ondanks het vertrek van meerdere sterkhouders en nieuwe blessures draait de Brusselse machine opnieuw op volle toeren. Peter Vandenbempt ziet zelfs een ploeg die aantrekkelijker oogt dan vroeger en opnieuw moeiteloos nieuwe smaakmakers naar voren schuift.

items.title: Complètement relancé(s) : Besnik Hasi au sommet grâce au pétard d'une ancienne terreur de Pro League
items.summary: Après son licenciement d'Anderlecht, Besnik Hasi s'est relancé en devenant l'entraîneur d'Amedspor. Les débuts en Turquie sont prometteurs, permettant au passage à un ancien attaquant de Pro League de renaître de ses cendres.

items.title: Stijn Stijnen zet Radja Nainggolan twee weken uit selectie en legt uit waarom
items.summary: Patro Eisden Maasmechelen moest het afgelopen weekend zonder Radja Nainggolan stellen in de competitiewedstrijd op het veld van Dender. De Limburgers verloren met 1-0, maar achteraf ging het vooral over de afwezigheid van de ervaren middenvelder. Intussen is duidelijk geworden dat daar een disciplinaire reden achter zat.

items.title: Accord trouvé : sans club depuis plusieurs mois, Alexander Blessin a retrouvé un banc de touche
items.summary: Alexander Blessin est actuellement sans club depuis la fin de son aventure à Sankt Pauli. Mais il devrait rapidement rebondir, tout en restant toujours au pays. Ce ne serait même qu'une question d'heures.

items.summary: Anderlecht won afgelopen weekend met 3-0 van Zulte Waregem, maar vooral het derde doelpunt zorgde voor flink wat verwarring. In de 53ste minuut leek Winkler de 3-0 te maken, maar scheidsrechter Simon Bourdeaud'hui keurde de treffer aanvankelijk af wegens een aanvallende fout.

items.title: Alexander Blessin (ex-Union en Oostende) heeft nieuwe uitdaging beet
items.summary: Alexander Blessin lijkt niet lang zonder club te blijven. De voormalige trainer van Union SG en Oostende staat dicht bij een terugkeer naar de Bundesliga, waar een traditieclub na een dramatische seizoensstart dringend op zoek is naar een nieuwe sportieve impuls.
